title: README: remove go report card
body:
[Go Report Card](https://github.com/gojp/goreportcard) was sunset on July 1, 2026, and its badge no longer provides useful information.

This PR removes the obsolete badge from the README.

#### Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?

```release-note
None
```

comments.body: Oops, looks like I misunderstood how those sign-offs work :sweat_smile:
